name: Miniflux
description: Minimalist and opinionated RSS feed reader.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://miniflux:{{envRaw.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-db/miniflux?sslmode=disable"
      RUN_MIGRATIONS: "1"
      CREATE_ADMIN: "1"
      ADMIN_USERNAME: {{env.ADMIN_USERNAME}}
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: {{env.ADMIN_PASSWORD}}
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-db
  {{serviceName}}-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: miniflux
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: miniflux
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
